bank_mapping.formula: 0x10 + (8-KiB PRG bank * 0x2000) + (CPU address - CPU window start)

scenario_1C.boundary_rule: Smallest greater pointer among all valid entries in the 256-entry table; stream end exclusive.
scenario_1C.bytes_hex: FD 00 FA 3E 9F F3 84 02 04 F2 9E B4 F2 B6 B4
decoded_from_handler_bytes: $FD $00 dispatches through bank-$10 $886A to $8877; the result depends on holder/record/$0638 state.
$FA $3E $9F enters nested bank-$10 target $9F3E through existing handler $881A and loader $80F6.

$F3 $84 dispatches selector $04 to $8259, which returns X=0 when $044E is 0/1 and X=1 when $044E is 2. Because $84 takes the high-bit handler path, X selects the inline skip byte: $02 resumes at $9BEC ($F2 $9E $B4), while $04 resumes at $9BEF ($F2 $B6 $B4).

The preceding $C624->$DCDF call initializes a zero $044E to 1+($00E2&1); a pre-existing nonzero value is preserved. Therefore the $B49E/$B4B6 branch is established for fresh zero-initialized $044E, while other incoming values remain context-dependent.
Each $F2 consumes its following little-endian pointer and replaces the active source address through handler $80F4. The selected B49E/B4B6 streams each contain one F9, one four-byte record, and FB.

f3_10.helper_behavior: Starts with X=0; if $043B==$01 it returns X=0; otherwise it calls $8677, increments X, and returns, so other selectors require that helper's result.

f3_1e_if_selected_at_9F4A.return_value: X=$043C&$7F; nonzero also sets bit $04 in $0516 via $8211

selected_branch_BB4B.selection_condition: $043B==$01 selects index 0 -> $9F4A, then $043C&$7F==0 selects index 0 -> $BB4B; the outer table's indexes 1-4 also target $BB4B.
selected_branch_BB4B.return: $BB4F $FB restores the saved FA caller stream at $9BE8 when this child is entered from root $9F3E.

nested_fa_dispatch.interpretation_limit: The $BB4B child is exact and bounded here. The other selected targets $B502/$B54F/$BB50 and their return behavior are not followed in this package.

handoff.caller_source: Existing extracted $DE6C-$DE96 bytes show $DE76->$E6EC, bank mapping helper $CE2D, then $801E->$8B4A; at $DE8D the caller loads $1C and calls $CBB0.
handoff.reader_source: Existing $EC08 scenario start maps bank $10 and calls $8000; reader entry $8000 resolves $0518 through pointer table $89BF.
handoff.route_observation_limit: This package is a static source extraction; it does not claim FCEUX/Godot runtime execution or resolve the complete scenario worker/output path.
